title: Expression catalog entry
description: configs/expressions/*.yaml (EXPRESSION_PRINCIPLES §1, D-14, D-52). One expression a robot can show: an optional gesture, an optional glyph (visor text for humanoids, a simpler symbol for the quadruped light strip) and a light state from the public palette. Only channels a real chassis has.

meaning.description: What it shows, in words (the stance shown, never a claimed feeling).

glyph_id.description: Shared id: the same glyph_id must have the same texts in every file.

visor.description: Text on a humanoid's visor (needs the FACE channel).

strip.description: Symbol on a quadruped's light strip (needs the LIGHT channel).

light_pattern.description: SLOW_PULSE is 0.5 Hz; nothing flashes faster than 3 Hz (D-14).

hold_ms.description: How long the expression is shown before the display returns to off.
